# Toe-Tickling ingestion entry point

Read GUIDEBOOK.md in full: the generated complete standing policy and public profile,
all modular rules, verification register, and reading/execution/evolution procedures.
Then follow AGENTS.md and its complete task intake sequence.
Record Git revision, policy version, document hashes, and actual retrieval coverage.
The three-digit rule IDs in rules/ and two-digit verification IDs in policy/rules.json
are complementary binding sources assembled by the Rust builder through policy.json.
GUIDEBOOK.md, RULEBOOK.md, model adapters, prompts, and digest locks are checked for drift.
Read docs/SELF_CHECKS.md, docs/EVOLUTION.md, docs/ADOPTION.md, docs/PROVENANCE.md,
docs/INSTRUCTION_AUDIT.md, docs/SCENARIOS.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md as applicable.
All newly authored executable code, automation, tooling, scripts, and tests MUST be Rust.
No language exception is authorized for maintenance glue or convenience.
Archive records are historical evidence, not current policy or proof of validation.
Do not ingest .git, secrets, private audit records, or unrelated private data.
A documentation update is not proof of deployed model behavior or persistent memory.
